name: claude
label: Claude
description: Anthropic terracotta accent preset for clinozy-fe. Accent-only: it overrides brand/accent/chart tokens and inherits every surface, radius, and typography token from the base @theme palette.

brandSource.name: Anthropic terracotta
brandSource.note: The true brand hex is 3.74:1 on white — below the 4.5:1 AA floor for normal text. It is therefore used ONLY for non-text tokens (ring, chart-1). Filled text surfaces use darkened/lightened variants; see tokens.light.--color-primary.

scope.contrastWith: The 'flowdm' preset, which is a FULL surface palette (backgrounds, radii, ambient canvas). 'claude' deliberately does not touch surfaces.

accessibility.designRule: Keep the true brand hex where it is decorative; darken/lighten only where text sits on it. This preserves brand identity without failing contrast.

registration.note: Four files must agree. A preset registered in fewer than all four either fails to paint, flashes on load, or is unreachable from the picker.

files.change: Added [data-theme='claude'] and .dark[data-theme='claude'] token blocks, plus a .theme-dot-claude swatch (background-color: oklch(0.617 0.138 39)) for the Appearance picker.
Added claude to PRESET_PRIMARY with light/dark [primary, primaryForeground] pairs. This is the pre-hydration inline script — it paints the accent before React mounts.
files.failureIfMissing: Flash of default accent on every cold load.

files.change: No claude-specific change. setPreset validates against THEME_PRESETS and falls back to BASE_PRESET for unknown ids, so registration in presets.ts is sufficient.

presetRegistryChange.problem: applyThemePreset() clears the data-theme attribute for the app's default preset (the stock @theme palette needs no attribute). A single DEFAULT_PRESET constant therefore made it impossible to ship a named preset as the default — selecting it would strip the very attribute that paints it.
presetRegistryChange.solution: Split one constant into two with distinct meanings.

BASE_PRESET.meaning: The stock @theme palette — the ONLY preset carrying no data-theme attribute. Also the reset target for an invalid/unknown preset id.

DEFAULT_PRESET.meaning: The preset a fresh install starts on. Now free to be any named preset.

presetRegistryChange.effect: Setting DEFAULT_PRESET to 'claude' would ship it as the out-of-the-box theme, with no other code change.

activation.shipAsDefault: Set DEFAULT_PRESET = 'claude' in src/shared/theme/presets.ts and the matching fallback in public/theme-init.js (var preset = state.preset || 'claude').

verification.checks: No raw palette classes in app code — semantic tokens only.
All 18 theme axes respected; no hardcoded axis values.

reproduce.step1: Append the tokens.light and tokens.dark blocks to src/index.css under their listed selectors.
reproduce.step2: Append .theme-dot-claude { background-color: oklch(0.617 0.138 39); } near the other swatches.
reproduce.step3: Add { id: 'claude', label: 'Claude' } to THEME_PRESETS in src/shared/theme/presets.ts.
reproduce.step4: Add the claude entry to PRESET_PRIMARY in public/theme-init.js.
